new_roles.assignment: Metadata only; 65/15/10/10 train/validation/calibration/test; old stimulus overlap excluded.

original_role_rows.algorithm: Union source physical/repeat group, global named template, duplicate exact path and shared seed. Within each homogeneous family+guide stratum with n>=4, enumerate positive integer role counts summing to n and minimize sum((count-role_fraction*n)^2/max(1,role_fraction*n)); round cost to12 decimals and break ties by (train,validation,calibration,test) count tuple. Stable-order groups by SHA256(seed|family|int(guide)|group_id), then allocate test,calibration,validation,train consecutive blocks. All union/stratum assumptions were checked on metadata.
original_role_rows.coverage_policy: At least one group per role where n>=4. For n<4, one group per role in sparse priority; missing cells explicit, no artificial source splitting.
original_role_rows.dataset_separation: Separate physical train+primary-validation, human-reference, and final artifacts. Trainer/model development cannot materialize human-reference or final arrays.
original_role_rows.person1_original_validation_continuity: Preserve all original rows in their sealed study; excluded final-template rows may be reported as historical continuity after new selection freeze, never in the new primary selection score.
